name: Numancia de la Sagra (Spain)
description: Quartered white and yellow with a red cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned arms of Numancia de la Sagra (a wheel above waves on white and a cross on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Numancia de la Sagra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Numancia de la Sagra arms — wheel above waves on white and a cross on yellow
